title: Cross Lingual Abstractive Summarization for Marathi
abstract: arXiv:2610.38267v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text summarization is an important task for advancing natural language processing (NLP) research and applications in Indic languages. Despite progress in extractive and abstractive summarization, both monolingual summarization (MS) and cross-lingual summarization (CLS) remain relatively underexplored for these languages. Recent advances in Transformer architectures, pretrained language models (PLMs), and dataset availability offer new opportunities to address this gap. In this work, we construct cross-lingual training data from the monolingual Marathi MahaSum corpus and combine it with the smaller cross-lingual PMIndiaSum dataset to fine-tune IndicTrans2, an Indic neural machine translation model. We evaluate the resulting models using ROUGE, chrF and chrF++ metrics, focusing primarily on Marathi-to-English summarization due to computational constraints. We also discuss the applicability of our approach to the English-to-Marathi direct

translated_title: 面向马拉地语的跨语言生成式摘要
translated_abstract: 文本摘要是推动印度语系语言自然语言处理（NLP）研究与应用发展的一项重要任务。尽管抽取式和生成式摘要已取得进展，但这些语言的单语摘要（MS）和跨语言摘要（CLS）仍相对缺乏探索。Transformer架构、预训练语言模型（PLM）以及数据集可用性方面的最新进展为填补这一空白提供了新机会。在这项工作中，我们从单语马拉地语MahaSum语料库构建跨语言训练数据，并将其与较小的跨语言PMIndiaSum数据集相结合，以微调IndicTrans2——一个印度语系神经机器翻译模型。我们使用ROUGE、chrF和chrF++指标对所得到的模型进行评估，受计算资源限制，主要聚焦于马拉地语到英语的摘要任务。我们还讨论了该方法在英语到马拉地语直接摘要方面的适用性。
tldr: 该论文的创新在于从单语马拉地语语料库构建跨语言训练数据，并微调印度语系机器翻译模型IndicTrans2，实现了马拉地语到英语的生成式跨语言摘要。
en_tdlr: The paper's key contribution is constructing cross-lingual training data from a monolingual Marathi corpus and fine-tuning the Indic neural machine translation model IndicTrans2 to achieve Marathi-to-English abstractive cross-lingual summarization.
